facts.text: Vatican City hosts its own telephone system, post office, gardens, astronomical observatory, radio station, banking system, pharmacy, and Swiss Guard contingent.
Since 1929, the Holy See has resided in Vatican City, established as an independent state to enable the pope to exercise universal authority.
Papal influence in central Italy grew in the 5th century as the Roman Empire fell, with people relying on the pope for protection from invading armies.
The Holy See’s authority extends over Catholics worldwide, making Vatican City the spiritual center for the global Catholic community.
The Swiss Guard, formed in 1506, remains the personal security force for the pope.
Vatican City’s astronomical observatory is one of the few in a sovereign microstate.
